limitations: Evidence class: software verification of identity bookkeeping (strings, digests, counts); no empirical validation (ADR 0069 section 10).

Only an install constrained by the shipped lock (pip install -c requirements.lock openflowsheet) is promised to verify; a plain pip install openflowsheet verifies only if the resolver picks the lock's versions for attrs, jsonschema-specifications, referencing and rpds-py, and otherwise records lock_sha256 = '' naming each member off the lock (ADR 0069 Amendment 1; X05.A25).

ADR 0069 section 10 still holds: it does not establish that a pre-X05 bundle with a non-empty hash was written at the lock; build identity under one version string (the lock has no hashes); that the metadata read is the module imported; anything about the extras or the reactor, NLP and LCA environments' own locks; the release procedure's provenance hash; platforms or Pythons outside the registered pair; performance; or empirical validation.
